units.summary: Generalizes the stale-series lookup into a filter that takes a predicate, now also used on caller-supplied refs in CompactSelectedSeries. It does not deduplicate refs and does not sort sortedByRef, so caller input passes straight through to postings and block writing.

issues.title: Duplicate caller refs produce duplicate series in sorted postings
issues.evidence:
sortedByRef = append(sortedByRef, ref)
		keptSeries = append(keptSeries, s)
issues.failure_scenario: CompactSelectedSeries([]SeriesRef{r, r}) puts r into sortedByLabels twice. The index writer then gets the same series twice and the compaction fails with an out-of-order series error, possibly after earlier chunk-range blocks were already written.

issues.title: Unsorted caller refs give a non-sorted 'sortedByRef' list
issues.evidence: //   - sortedByRef preserves the order of the input postings
issues.failure_scenario: If refs are passed unsorted, sortedByRef is unsorted, and any Postings or Intersect call on it outside the AllPostings marker path silently returns wrong results.

units.headline: Stale-series filter generalized to take a keep predicate
units.reason: Core filtering logic now runs on caller-supplied, unvalidated refs.
focus: duplicate or unsorted refs passed to CompactSelectedSeries
nil keep skips locking; check that's safe for later use

units.summary: Reimplements the stale-series lookup on top of the new filter, with the predicate isSeriesWithoutOOO && isStaleSeries checked under the series lock. Behavior should match the old inline checks.
units.headline: Stale ref lookup now delegates to filterSeriesAndSortPostings
units.reason: Refactor of the compaction selection path; a reviewer should confirm the predicate is equivalent.
focus: predicate equivalence with the old OOO and stale-NaN checks
